data.name: Kacper
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Polish word ‘kazać’, which means ‘to prepare’ or ‘to make ready’. This name is a nod to the biblical figure of St. Caspar, who was a wise man from the East who visited the baby Jesus. Caspar is also known as Melchior, and the three wise men from the East are traditionally named Melchior, Caspar, and Balthasar.
